## Checklist

- [ ] Text and comments say what the code does, not why it was chosen.
- [ ] No planning text, ticket numbers or internal identifiers in files or commit messages.
- [ ] Folders and files are named by component.
- [ ] Anything not built is described as "not in this version".
- [ ] Every issuer surface is marked SIMULATED.
- [ ] Privacy tests are unchanged or stronger, and pass.
- [ ] No personal data in any log entry, root or transaction.
